record_title: Exact strict s-numbers of pointwise multipliers on C0-spaces
provenance: The proof factors finite superlevel witnesses through isometric copies of finite-dimensional l-infinity, uses finite-rank superlevel truncations for the matching upper bounds, and uses disjoint compactly supported functions for the strictly singular obstruction.
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The full theorem text of Aksoy--Lewicki (1997) was not inspected, and older diagonal, central, and disjointness-preserving operator literature remains a priority risk. The result concerns scalar pointwise multipliers on C0-spaces; no complemented infinite-dimensional c0 witness is asserted.
